newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Moos sees no chance for steel merger.
newsitem.headline: Von Moos sees no chance for steel merger.

text.p: Von Moos Holding AG said on Thursday it did not belive there was a chance for a merger of Swiss steelmakers into one group after it backed out of a deal to buy a division of Von Roll Holding AG.
Von Moos spokesman Paul Wiesli told Reuters his group was very disappointed over the conditions it found at Von Roll's Swiss steelmaking division.
"I believe that this (Swiss steel merger) will no longer effectively come about," Wiesli said.
Von Moos earlier announced it was declaring the June 28 contract invalid.
Von Moos sees no chance for steel =2
No comment was available from Von Roll two hours after the von Moos statement. A Von Roll spokesman said the group had been surprised and was still formulating a response.
The pact, under which von Moos agreed to buy the Von Roll Stahl AG division, would have left von Moos as the sole steel producer in Switzerland.
But von Moos alleged its review of the Von Roll division had found higher than expected costs for environmental protection, lower production capacity and an estimated negative cash flow for 1996.
"It was a great disappointment for us," Wiesli said.
